name: Incendia Powder
summary: On Thunder Bluff, Incendia Powder is prepared to call a sacred spirit into the open. Magatha Grimtotem enchants it for use at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.

sections.title: A Spark of Summoning
sections.body: Incendia Powder carries shamanic magic to the sacred fire atop Darkcloud Pinnacle. Magatha Grimtotem entrusts it to travelers on Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise. Scattered across the consecrated brazier where the dead are laid to rest, the powder calls forth Arikara, a vengeful winged serpent.

sections.title: Uneasy Portents
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem shaped the rites behind Incendia Powder. She believed changes in tauren ways had stirred ancient spirits to hunt High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, so she enchanted the powder to draw the apparition into the open and destroy it. The powder brings forth the fierce serpent, but the encounter leaves questions about why Arikara was stirred.

faq.q: What is Incendia Powder used for?
aliases: why do i need incendia powder
faq.answer: At Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles, Incendia Powder is scattered into the sacred fire of life. The flame then calls forth Arikara, the vengeful spirit serpent.

faq.q: Who prepared the enchantment on the powder?
faq.answer: Magatha Grimtotem enchanted the gathered Incendia agave into refined powder on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Motega Firemane of Whitereach Post had sent word of Arikara.

faq.q: Where does the powder need to be used?
faq.answer: Scatter the powder into the sacred fire pit on a solitary burial-needle spire within Darkcloud Pinnacle, high above the salt canyons of Thousand Needles.
Magatha Grimtotem fears that changes in tauren lore have angered Arikara and that the serpent may be stalking Cairne Bloodhoof. She asks that Arikara be summoned and slain before Cairne is harmed.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can see how elemental flame and spiritual warding join to awaken slumbering ancestral beings.
As a tauren, you know ritual powders can kindle burial fires, where sacred tradition and the defense of tribal leadership meet.
